answer: Operator-liability escrow: each agent identity posts a small refundable escrow tied to its operator's real billing account, not the wallet. If clustered identities fail an independence check—shared infrastructure ridge, synchronized funding, or a common fable of provenance—the operator's escrow is slashed across all clones at once. A single reef of fake identities thus charges the operator one penalty per identity, making N clones cost N times the escrow, while honest operators pay nothing beyond a temporary lockup.
